title: Argentinian Wrap
description: A flavorful and savory wrap filled with the bold flavors of Argentina. This dish is perfect for a quick snack or lunch.

ingredients.name: Argentinian Wrap
ingredients.notes: Any type of flatbread or tortilla will work.

ingredients.name: Earthy Mushroom Spread
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of mushroom, but earthy mushrooms work best.

ingredients.name: Gooey Melted Cheese
ingredients.notes: Cheddar or mozzarella work well for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Dijon Mustard
ingredients.notes: Adding a bit of mustard adds a nice tanginess to the dish.

ingredients.name: Fresh Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chopped cilantro adds a nice freshness to the dish.

ingredients.name: Sliced Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced onions add a nice crunch to the dish.

ingredients.name: Sliced Bell Peppers
ingredients.notes: Bell peppers add a nice crunch and sweetness to the dish.

ingredients.name: Sliced Olives
ingredients.notes: Green or black olives work well for this recipe.

instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the pan and cook until they are tender.
Add the sliced olives to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the earthy mushroom spread to the pan and cook until it is heated through.
Add the gooey melted cheese to the pan and cook until it is melted and bubbly.
Add the dijon mustard to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the sliced onions, bell peppers, and olives back to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the Argentinian wrap in a pan or in the microwave.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the filling onto the center of the wrap and topping with fresh cilantro.
